title: Atelier benchmark run row
description: One row per benchmark run in evals/metrics/log.jsonl. See SCHEMA.md for units, sources and the derived cost per accepted PR.

run_id.description: Unique id for the run. Use a timestamp plus the ticket number, for example 20261118T1430-t02.

date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date the run finished, YYYY-MM-DD.

ticket.description: Benchmark ticket number, 1 to 5, matching evals/tickets/NN-slug/.

routing.description: Model names used for each agent in this run.

branch.description: Git branch the run built on, as named in the host repo.

first_try_ci_pass.description: True when the first CI run on the first PR push passed with no fix commits.

invented_component_count.description: Components the Builder used that are not in the design system manifest, from the assumptions log (G1).

axe_violations.description: axe counts across all shots in the run, from the render manifest (G5).

critic_score.description: Mean of the five principle scores P1 to P5, taken from the last /build pass of the Critic (G10). Unit: score on a 1 to 5 scale.

review_minutes.description: Minutes from the Critic's findings being posted in the session to the owner's one-line verdict at /wrap step 3. Self-reported, rounded to the nearest 0.5. Unit: minutes.

critic_issues_agreed.description: Taken from the last /build pass. agreed counts findings the owner marked fix or later. disagree is not agreed. Findings with no token are excluded from total. agreed must not exceed total.

cost_usd.description: Estimated spend for this run in USD, whether or not the PR was accepted. Taken from the usage shown for the session. Unit: USD, estimate.

accepted.description: True when this run's PR was merged.
